primary_estimand: Paper's exercise estimand: post-exercise vs baseline plasma exRNA miRNAs (S2.11, S4.6.2.8.p1), samples in GSE121874. GSE123865 is the RNA Isolation Kits study (S4.3.7.3.p1): pooled healthy-donor serum/plasma processed with different RNA isolation kits; no exercise factor.
planned_contrasts: post-Exercise vs Baseline miRNAs (S2.11.p3, S4.6.2.8.p1; paper: 53 DE miRNAs) -- samples in GSE121874, not in GSE123865
paper_method: deconvolution + t-test per cargo profile (FDR); DESeq2 Baseline vs post-Exercise on read counts
role_of_this_accession: RNA isolation kit comparison on 4 pools (female/male x serum/plasma) from 20 healthy donors; n=182
